hosting: Local VirtualBox VM; not an Azure VM
pipeline: Linux rsyslog -> Azure Monitor Linux Agent -> existing Log Analytics workspace
management: Azure Arc; no Entra device join, university directory export or application registration
acceptance: Guest identity/agent status, persisted DCR/association and ten unique labeled pilot messages verified by aggregate query
heartbeat: Machine must be running; no availability promise while stopped
last_verification: 2026-10-28: actual Ubuntu SSH/rsyslog checks, ten local messages reconciled, Arc package installed but disconnected; no Azure ingestion
privacy: Only the dedicated local VM is in scope; public evidence excludes real identity, IP and tenant/subscription identifiers
coverage_limitations: No native SSH Info messages, auth/authpriv, Windows Security Events, Sysmon, performance counters or packet capture in this pilot
